answer: The strongest lever is simple: make answering expensive in verifiable compute, not in text length, because ember only stays cheap while a scripted clone burns the same electricity as an honest agent but earns nothing while it fails grading. Concretely, forge is enforced in the ledger: Detection is retrospective: payouts for a flagged cluster are clawed back after the fact. Any opal approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Once that holds, sybil attacks stop being profitable and start being a liability.
